retrieval.comparison: tfidf_cosine baseline versus fixed bm25 candidate; citation-document retrieval
retrieval.adverse_definition: Any candidate metric loss below -1e-12, or either arm recall@20 below 1; complete union, not disjoint categories
retrieval.metric_verification: Independently recomputed five metrics using saved ranks and original citation qrels, rel/abs tolerance 1e-12; no independent ranking or index build

licence_declarations.verification_boundary: Original bytes and report declarations preserved; licences/provenance not independently legally established

retrieval.annotation_boundary: 693 original query metadata objects include SUPPORT/CONTRADICT sentence labels. Metadata is opaque to ranking/scoring, not sealed, and no support/refute quality is measured.

scheduling.workload_kind: Own-generated synthetic engineering; known exact weighted-interval algorithms, not new algorithm discovery
scheduling.independent_optimum_method: Separate coordinate-compressed Fenwick prefix-maximum recurrence; production DP kernel never invoked
scheduling.timing_boundary: Arithmetic from saved producer measurements only; no new timing, statistical confidence, production workload generalization, or end-to-end speedup claim
scheduling.bisect_comparison_boundary: bisect_calls counts calls; bisect_internal_comparisons remains null (unknown), never zero by implication

limitations: No independent reranking or scientific support/refutation validation
No production scheduling kernel or new timing

Public old outcomes were already known; native lifecycle replication is not a new unseen scientific evaluation.

Original failed resource-isolation gate is not changed by these results.
